Located in the heart of the Upper West Side of New York City, our flexible all-day tickets let you explore at your own pace. Designed for young learners ages 0–6 , CMOM’s ever-changing programs and exhibits make learning through play exciting. Whether it’s your first visit or your fiftieth, there’s always something new to discover. Get Tickets (opens in new tab) What’s On Today Admissions Admission to CMOM includes access to all exhibits and daily public programs. Stay and play as long as you like! Visitors can even leave and come back later in the same day—just ask for a return sticker from Security or Guest Services at the door! Tickets can be purchased online in advance or right before your visit, and you’ll save $1 when you book online. Walk-up tickets are also available but reserving ahead ensures your spot. Members enjoy unlimited visits and may use their membership cards for admission anytime . Learn more about discounted admission options here. Adults Tickets In-Person: $18 $17 Online Pricing Buy Tickets Children (Ages 1–18) Tickets In-Person: $18 $17 Online Pricing Buy Tickets Infant (Under 12 months old) Free Buy Tickets Senior (65 and over with ID) Tickets In-Person: $15 $14 Online Pricing Buy Tickets Visitor With Disabilities Tickets In-Person: $15 $14 Online Pricing Buy Tickets Members Free Included in Membership Learn More Know Before You Go We’re dedicated to joyful learning, creativity, and community—a place where children and families come together to explore, create, and play. To help ensure everyone has a safe, fun, and welcoming experience , please review our visitor guidelines and helpful FAQs . You’ll find important information on tickets, hours, museum policies, accessibility, and more—all organized in easy-to-browse sections to help you plan your visit. For general questions, please email us at [email protected] . If you know the department you need, you can find contact information—including email addresses and phone numbers—in the FAQ . What Age Group is CMOM Designed For? CMOM is designed especially for children ages 0–6, a time of important brain development and growth. Our hands-on exhibits and programs support early learning through play, creativity, and exploration. While older children may enjoy select exhibits and programs, most of our spaces are specifically created for toddlers, preschoolers, and early elementary-age kids. We encourage grown-ups to play too! Food & Drink To keep our exhibits clean, safe for play, and free of allergens, food and beverages are not allowed inside the building. We do allow baby formula and water, and there are water bottle refill stations by the restrooms. While CMOM does not offer a cafeteria, you are welcome to leave and return throughout the day to enjoy nearby dining options and discount offers. Strollers For your convenience, complimentary stroller and coat check is available at CMOM. To ensure a safe and comfortable experience for all visitors, strollers are not permitted in exhibit areas. School Field Trips Visiting with a group of 15 or more students, campers, or a large group? On weekdays we offer specially curated 90-minute guided tours led by our expert educators. Advanced reservations are required to ensure the best experience for your group. Visit our Guided Field Trips page and contact our team for more information. Accessibility CMOM is committed to being a welcoming space for all visitors. The Museum is wheelchair accessible. Please note that the lower level of the Dynamic H2O exhibition has limited accessibility. Personal care attendants accompanying visitors with disabilities receive free admission. We offer a fully accessible restroom on the Third Floor and an ambulatory accessible restroom on the Lower Level. We also have accessible elevators and stroller parking. If you need assistance during your visit, our staff is happy to help. Personal care attendants accompanying visitors with disabilities receive free admission. Sensory Kits are also available to borrow at no additional cost during your visit. Each kit is designed to help children regulate, refocus, and feel at ease, and includes: Over-the-ear headphones for noise reduction A sand timer to support transitions Fidget toys to encourage self-regulation and focus Kits are available at the Admissions desk and in PlayWorks on the 3rd floor. Simply check one out at the start of your visit and return it before you leave. Learn more about our Accessibility Programing. Museum Policies To ensure a safe and enjoyable visit for everyone, we’ve put together a set of visitor guidelines. You can learn more on this page . Questions? Please visit our Frequently Asked Questions page. You can also call us at 212-721-1223 or send us an email to [email protected] . The CMOM Experience Daily Programming From ever-changing themed activities to PlayWorks , our dedicated space for our youngest visitors, every experience is designed to engage children at the right developmental stage. With a rotating schedule of interactive programs, there’s always a reason to visit and discover something exciting! PlayWorks Schedule: Daily programs for our youngest learners 0–4, with activities changing regularly on weekdays and weekends. 10:30 am – 11:00 am: Circle Time 11:15 am – 12:15 pm: Mural Wall or Messy with Art 1:45 pm – 2:30 pm: Special Daily Program or Mural Wall 2:45 pm – 3:45 pm: Messy with Art 4:00 pm: Alphie’s Goodbye Storytime Events Calendar Explore Our Exhibits Explore four floors of hands-on, research based, interactive exhibits designed to spark curiosity, creativity, and a love of learning. View Our Exhibits Early Childhood Classes Designed to meet the needs of young learners, our classes offer your child an opportunity to immerse themselves in learning. Explore Early Childhood Classes Join the CMOM Community Become a member, support our mission, and stay connected with special events and exclusive perks. Welcome to CMOM, NYC’s premier destination for interactive learning and play! Located on the Upper West Side, our engaging exhibits and programs inspire children ages 0-6 to explore arts, science, and culture through hands-on experiences. For over 50 years, CMOM has nurtured curiosity, creativity, and lifelong learning in a joyful, safe environment designed specifically for the development of young minds. Plan your family’s adventure today! Plan Your Visit Get Your Tickets (opens in new tab) What’s Happening Join us for exciting educational experiences that bring learning to life through play. Daily Experiences Access to unique public programs and activities. Learn More Exhibits Inspiring children ages 0-6 to explore through hands-on learning. Learn More Classes Immersive learning through unique ongoing early childhood education classes Learn More Unlimited Access: Become a Member The best way to experience CMOM? Becoming a Member! With one simple purchase, enjoy unlimited visits—and special perks including early access on the first Saturday of every month. Join Today PlayWorks™ Adventures With Dora and Diego Inside Art: Create, Climb, Collaborate Dynamic H₂O Right to Vote Installation: Superheroine La Borinqueña by Edgardo Miranda-Rodriguez There’s Always Something To Explore At CMOM, every exhibit is designed with purpose, guided by research, and developed in collaboration with expert advisors in early childhood learning. Unlike traditional play spaces, our exhibits go beyond entertainment; they are scientifically crafted to support cognitive, social-emotional, and physical development through the power of play. Exhibits Families in Temporary Housing Through community programs and partnerships, we bring arts education, early childhood development, and joyful learning experiences to children and families for children and caregivers living in temporary housing. Families in Temporary Housing Family Connections Through hands-on workshops and dedicated learning hubs at Rikers Island, CMOM’s Family Connections Program strengthens family relationships impacted by incarceration and fosters hope for the future. Family Connections Support Our Mission Every visit, every class, and every smile at CMOM is made possible by people like you. Explore all the ways you can get involved and help us build brighter futures for New York City’s kids.
